NEXORA
Sovereign On-Premise Agentic AI Workbench using Open-Weight Multimodal LLMs for
Confidential Industrial Work
 
 
A self-hosted AI workbench runs open-
weight models locally and automatically
selects the most suitable model for each
task, without sending confidential data
outside the organization.
An agentic workflow plans and performs
multi-step tasks using local file tools,
internal knowledge search, sandboxed
code execution, and iterative reasoning.
A multimodal AI system understands
scanned PDFs, handwritten notes,
engineering drawings, images, and
documents, and generates practical work
outputs such as reports, approval notes,
calculations, presentations, and code.
 
•
•
•
•
Industrial organizations work with sensitive engineering,
financial, inspection, and internal data that cannot be shared
with public AI tools. This leaves teams dependent on manual
work, slowing down analysis and reducing productivity.
NOVA is a self-hosted sovereign AI workbench that runs open-weight multimodal
models on the organization's own infrastructure. It enables secure local AI for
confidential industrial work, with automatic model selection and agentic workflows
that can understand documents, use local tools, and generate practical outputs.
Model-agnostic AI supports multiple
open-weight models with automatic task-
based model selection.
Agentic workflow plans and executes
multi-step industrial tasks using local
tools and enterprise knowledge.
Multimodal AI understands scanned
documents, drawings, images, and
handwritten notes for industrial use.
Sovereign deployment keeps sensitive
data on-premise and air-gapped with no
external data flow.

Local deployment: Runs on a single workstation/GPU

Modular architecture: Supports adding new models and

Local processing: RAG and AI inference run within the

Controlled execution: Sandboxed tools and validation help

NOVA differentiates through on-premise agentic AI, combining
open-weight models, multimodal processing, local knowledge, and
tool-based execution in one workbench.
